question: Using a recursive monthly inventory adjustment model starting from December 2018 inventory levels, where we restock a product if its ending inventory drops below the minimum required level, determine for each product the month in 2019 where the absolute difference between its ending inventory and the minimum required level is the smallest, and return the product_id, that month, and the absolute difference.
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE inventory_model AS (
  SELECT 
    it.product_id,
    CAST('2018-12-01' AS VARCHAR) AS mth,
    CAST(it.qty AS DOUBLE) AS ending_inventory,
    pm.qty_minimum,
    pm.qty_purchase,
    CAST(0.0 AS DOUBLE) AS abs_diff
  FROM inventory_totals it
  JOIN product_minimums pm ON it.product_id = pm.product_id
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    im.product_id,
    CAST(mb.mth AS VARCHAR) AS mth,
    CAST(
      CASE 
        WHEN (im.ending_inventory - mb.qty) < pm.qty_minimum 
        THEN im.ending_inventory - mb.qty + pm.qty_purchase
        ELSE im.ending_inventory - mb.qty
      END AS DOUBLE
    ) AS ending_inventory,
    pm.qty_minimum,
    pm.qty_purchase,
    CAST(
      CASE 
        WHEN (im.ending_inventory - mb.qty) < pm.qty_minimum 
        THEN ABS(im.ending_inventory - mb.qty + pm.qty_purchase - pm.qty_minimum)
        ELSE ABS(im.ending_inventory - mb.qty - pm.qty_minimum)
      END AS DOUBLE
    ) AS abs_diff
  FROM inventory_model im
  JOIN product_minimums pm ON im.product_id = pm.product_id
  JOIN monthly_budget mb ON im.product_id = mb.product_id 
    AND CAST(mb.mth AS DATE) = CAST(im.mth AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1' MONTH
  WHERE CAST(mb.mth AS DATE) <= DATE '2019-12-01'
)
SELECT product_id, mth, abs_diff
FROM inventory_model
WHERE mth >= '2019-01-01'
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY abs_diff ASC, mth ASC) = 1
ORDER BY product_id
